sections.text:
Student Code of Conduct
The institution is committed to providing a safe, respectful, and inclusive learning environment. All 
students are expected to conduct themselves responsibly and uphold the values of honesty, integrity, 
and mutual respect.
Respect for Others
Students must:
•
Treat fellow students, lecturers, staff, and visitors with courtesy and respect.
•
Avoid discrimination, harassment, bullying, or intimidation in any form.
•
Respect the opinions, beliefs, and cultural backgrounds of others.
•
Use appropriate language and behavior while on campus.
Classroom Conduct
To maintain an effective learning environment, students should:
•
Arrive on time for all classes.
•
Participate actively and respectfully in classroom discussions.
•
Keep mobile phones on silent mode unless instructed otherwise by the lecturer.
•
Avoid actions that interrupt teaching or distract other students.
•
Follow the lecturer's instructions throughout the class.
Care of School Property
Students are responsible for helping maintain campus facilities by:
•
Keeping classrooms, laboratories, and common areas clean.
•
Using school equipment properly and responsibly.
•
Reporting damaged or unsafe equipment to the appropriate office.
•
Paying for any damage caused intentionally or through negligence.
Use of Technology
Students are encouraged to use technology responsibly for educational purposes.
Students must:
•
Use the institution's internet and computer facilities in accordance with school policies.
•
Protect their usernames and passwords.
•
Respect copyright laws and intellectual property rights.

•
Avoid accessing inappropriate or harmful content using school resources.
Health and Safety
Students should contribute to a safe campus by:
•
Following all health and safety regulations.
•
Participating in emergency drills when required.
•
Reporting accidents, injuries, or safety hazards immediately.
•
Refraining from bringing prohibited or dangerous items onto campus.
Disciplinary Actions
Students who violate institutional rules may be subject to disciplinary action depending on the 
seriousness of the offense.
Possible disciplinary actions include:
•
Verbal warning
•
Written warning
•
Community service
•
Suspension from classes or activities
•
Expulsion from the institution
The institution will ensure that disciplinary matters are handled fairly and in accordance with 
established policies.
Student Commitment
By enrolling in the institution, students agree to:
•
Follow all institutional policies and regulations.
•
Maintain academic honesty and personal integrity.
•
Respect members of the campus community.
•
Contribute to a positive, safe, and productive learning environment.
•
Represent the institution with professionalism and responsibility both on and off campus.
